scientific_depth.justification: The SLO mechanism is now decomposed across three Monte Carlo seeds. The paper reports the result plainly: 'the 50 W idle-power advantage of reuse-based hosts explains only a small part of the 63-130 tCO2e operational gap, which stems mainly from the smaller reserve. We did not isolate why the reuse fleet needs less reserve.' It frames the effect as 'reuse does not lose under a guarantee' (0.025-0.039 pp). By-construction floors are acknowledged. Three limits remain. The root cause of the 2.6-3.6% smaller reserve is unknown, so the Abstract's 'because' explains the result only proximately. The headline SLO price ('up to 0.82%') depends on a correlation level k=0.5 that the appendix calls 'illustrative, not fitted', yet the Abstract does not say so. The entry age a_0 (5 years) underpins the premise that 'reused parts are old', but it is never swept; the hazard multiplier m is only a partial proxy for it.

technical_execution.justification: The implementation details are now essentially complete. Section 3.1 states 'reused DIMMs and SSDs enter at a_0=5 years and all parts of old_gpu ... at a_0=4 years'. Initial-fleet ages, per-repair logistics carbon, the scope of the screening yield and all cost settings appear in Section 4.1 and Table 6. Section 3.3 now says beta_LC=1 is used inside the LP when the reserve is active. The hard cap no longer applies. Three things hold the score back. Seed replication covers only the single decomposition setting; Table 4 and Figure 6 are single-seed. There is no sensitivity analysis on a_0 or on the dispersion k, although the SLO price roughly doubles from independent failures to k=0.5. The LP-relaxation validation rests on one 36-node pilot whose MIP did not reach proven optimality.

logical_flow.justification: The narrative remains clean from the Abstract's three-part answer through Sections 5.2-5.4 to the Conclusion. The mechanism paragraph now flows from decomposition to seed ranges to an honest statement of what was not isolated. The design implication on standby states is correctly scoped as future work. Section 5.5 still packs accounting, fuzzy, utilization and cost studies into one paragraph. Three appendix items carry results cited in the main text (Tables 5 and 7, Figure 7). Page 11 still has noticeable float whitespace.

writing_clarity.justification: The prose is precise and the notation consistent (Delta for hours per quarter, age units stated). The Abstract's sign claim is now correctly scoped: 'at node level on the mixed grid, the saving changes sign across the placeholder range of the CXL slowdown'. Section 5.4 gives the seed-0 values ('from 0.775% to 0.812%'), while the Abstract and Introduction give the three-seed range (0.800-0.814%), and the text never says which seed Table 4 uses. 'Anywhere between nothing and about three times the nominal value' is informal and understates 3.4x. ECC is not expanded.

evidence_presentation.justification: The figure and table mismatches are fixed. The Figure 3 caption now matches its panels. Table 3 includes the spares-plus-logistics column and states that the components 'sum to the added carbon up to leased capacity' (3,241 + 465 + 97 = 3,803 against 3,806). Table 5 gives the range and value behind every Figure 2 bar. Table 4 shows 0.499, matching the text. Seed ranges appear only for added carbon in Table 3. Capacity, operational and embodied ranges are given only in prose. The other eleven SLO settings in Table 4 and Figure 6 have no uncertainty. The '2.6x the reserve' claim has no supporting table.

academic_style.justification: The tone is measured and professional, with hedges placed where the evidence is thin and no defensive language. Figure labels are paper-level. Terminology is mostly consistent, although 'CXL slowdown' and 'CXL throughput multiplier' still alternate. 'External supply arrives pre-screened' adds an assumption that the evidence base does not state. The main text uses exactly the full 12-page budget, leaving no margin for camera-ready additions.
